item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed Connectors in Azure Functions
item.description:
Managed connectors in Azure Functions are now generally available. They let developers build event-driven applications that respond to events and trigger actions across Microsoft 365, SaaS, and business systems using the Azure Functions programming model.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported a high-volume phishing campaign that used Microsoft 365 outage-themed lures to target organizations across multiple industries worldwide.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
item.description:
Microsoft says Storm-0940 used ARTEX agentic AI to speed up a ConnectWise supply-chain compromise and then abuse application credentials in Microsoft 365 environments.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
